items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The first movie I made was The Notorious Landlady with Jack Lemmon and Kim Novak.

ctx.x: Oh gosh. I hadn’t gone to New York yet. I would say it was 1958, The Notorious Landlady with Jack Lemmon and Kim Novak.
I’ll check Netflicks. See if I can get it.
